name: fix-deck-rebuilt-tracing
body: source: domain.entity.deck-rebuilt realised-by solution.component.deck-page only; inconsistency: the event traced only to its browser consumer, not to the components that produce and deliver it (feedback-9); resolution: added realised-by deck-rebuilt → file-watcher (emits it after re-validation/re-render) and deck-rebuilt → http-server (its live-reload endpoint pushes it to browsers), keeping deck-page (reloads on it); component bodies updated to name those roles. Push transport left as "live-reload endpoint" (SSE vs websocket not fixed by the spec) [autonomous, per coordinator direction].
